lines.text: The gap closes behind you. Where the wall was, there is only glass.
The moss is up to your ankles. The ferns are as tall as trees.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: A terrarium. Somebody keeps a whole garden in a jar. And now us.
A bottle cap as big as a table. Somebody dropped it in from above.
A mushroom. It glows a little, like a night light.
A jar is standing in front of the only crack in the glass. It has feet.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Nothing leaves. That is the job. Things go in the glass and they stay in the glass.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Lid on!

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: If the lid comes off, everything dries up and blows away. So. Lid on. Always.
You poke three small holes. A little night air comes in. Nothing blows away.
You water the big fern. It leans toward the holes.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: ...Someone to visit. Nobody ever said that part.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: No! That lets everything out!
The glass slides a little closer.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Stop pushing! You'll crack something!

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Back in the moss! In!

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: I am sealed tight! Tight!

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Stay.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: The glass is closer now.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Closer.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: There. Snug.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: Holes in the lid. Visitors. Fine. You may go out. Come back in sometimes.
You got a drop of dew.

lines.speaker: jar_keeper
lines.text: You... you leaked.
The Jar Keeper rolls away into the ferns.
The crack in the glass is open. Night air comes through.
A wall of vines, pulled tight. One pale flower is shut, like it is sleeping.
Something in this part of the garden is asleep too.
The mushroom opens its cap and glows.
Somewhere close, vines let go with a long creak.
The mushroom opens its cap and glows.
Far behind you, more vines let go.
The mushroom opens its cap and glows.
The last vines let go. Something heavy turns to look.
A bottle cap, tucked away where nobody looks. There is a drop of dew under it.
You got a drop of dew.
